subject.title: fix(agents): repair orphaned tool_use pairs on compaction prune path

question: Should built-in compaction use the existing prompt-send drop policy for aborted assistant tool-call turns, or should this PR use a different recovery policy before merge?
rationale: The patch is mechanically sound, but it intentionally discards interrupted assistant tool-call turns from compaction input; only maintainers can accept that session-state tradeoff or require a broader provider-backed compaction repair.

options.title: Accept drop policy and merge
options.body: Use the existing prompt-send sanitizer policy in compaction, accepting small interrupted-turn context loss to prevent strict-provider session breakage.

options.title: Require synthetic interrupted results
options.body: Ask the PR to preserve the assistant turn by inserting an explicit interrupted tool result and add proof that strict providers accept it.

options.title: Broaden before merge
options.body: Require the same pairing repair before pluggable compaction providers receive messages, so custom provider-backed safeguard compaction is covered too.

recommendation.title: Accept drop policy and merge
recommendation.body: Use the existing prompt-send sanitizer policy in compaction, accepting small interrupted-turn context loss to prevent strict-provider session breakage.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest history on the shared transcript repair contract that determines the drop-versus-synthesize policy.
